name: vcruz305/dsv4.1-flash-1017-exl3-spark-recipe
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 at 1.62 bpw experts (SAGE-EXL3) runs on one 128 GB DGX Spark
summary: An independent quantizer published an EXL3 checkpoint of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 with routed experts at 1.62 bits per weight, plus a one-Spark vLLM serving recipe. He reports 35.5 tok/s decode, up to 1,189 tok/s prefill and 229K context on a single GB10, and teacher-forced agreement with the native release of 99.61% on HumanEval answer tokens and 94.52% top-1 overall.
